doc: Build a directory of pages into a site whose every route is its semantic tree written as HTML and as Markdown; list a site's routes; read one page as an agent that only fetches would, and search every page's sections, without building the site.

tools.name: site.build
tools.description: Build the site: each page of pages/ a route with its index.html (the tree as HTML: readable with no script) and index.md (the tree as Markdown), the routes table, llms.txt and, given the site's address, sitemap.xml

site.description: a file or directory path: the site's directory (it holds pages/)

out.description: a file or directory path: the directory written

title.description: the site's title (default: its first page's)

languages.description: its languages, the default first: en,zh — a first directory of that name is that language's pages

url.description: where it is served (https://example.org/docs/): the sitemap's addresses

tools.name: routes.list
tools.description: The routes a site's pages give: each its address, source, title, language and headings with their anchors

site.description: a file or directory path: the site's directory

tools.name: page.read
tools.description: One route as it would be written, without building the site: its Markdown (what an agent that only fetches reads) or its HTML

site.description: a file or directory path: the site's directory

languages.description: the site's languages, the default first

tools.name: docs.search
tools.description: The sections of a site's pages that hold every word asked for, best first: each its route, its anchor, the headings it is under and the line that says so — the same index a built site serves as search.xdef.json

site.description: a file or directory path: the site's directory

query.description: the words; text without spaces between words matches by characters in a row

languages.description: the site's languages, the default first
